༄༅/ /rin chen shog 'dra/rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /mkha' 'gro yang tig/

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rin chen shog 'dra/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo bzhugs so//

mkha' 'gro yang tig / rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// yid bzhin re ba kun 'grub cing*// 'dod dgu'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa// ye shes mtsho rgyal la btud de// rdo rje g.yu sgron sgrub thabs bshad// 'di la phyi nang gsang ba gsum// phyi ltar sman btsun mched lnga la// nang ltar yid 'ong lha mo lnga// gsang bar mkha' 'gro lnga yin pas// sku gsung thugs yin 'di ltar bsgrub// dang po phyi ltar sgrub pa ni// yid dang mthun pa'i gangs ri 'am// nags ri spang ri skyed mos tshal// dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas nyid du// maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng*// sman mo'i gzugs dang me long mda'// dar sna lngas brgyan bzhag par bya// mtha' skor dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// me tog la sogs mchod pa bsham// de nas rang nyid skad cig gis// pad+ma 'byung gnas bsgoms byas pa// mdun du gangs ri skyed mos tshal// dbus na rin chen khang bzang ste// de nang rin chen khri steng du// rdo rje g.yu sgron dkar gsal ni// dar dkar na bza' gser g.yus brgyan// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu ste// g.yon na dngul dkar me long 'dzin// dar thod me long phreng rgyan can// 'dzum bcas phyed krung 'od zer 'phro// phyogs bzhir mched bzhi gtso mo 'dra// kun kyang bcu drug na tshod la// sgeg mdzes dgyes pa'i tshul du bsgom// snying ga'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas// gnas sman gangs ri lha yi gnas// sprin dkar dag pa'i pho brang nas// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim// dngos dang yid kyis mchod byas la// sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas par bya// ā+oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hriṃ hriṃ swā hā/ bdag nyid pad+ma'i 'od zer ni// phog pas de dag sku gsung thugs// dgyes pas rin chen char 'beb cing*// 'dod dgu'i bsam pa bsgrub par bsam// rjes la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi// gtor ma 'bru gsum byin brlabs la// oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes pa lnga 'am bdun gyis dbul// bstod pa 'di yang brjod par bya// rdo rje g.yu sgron shin tu mdzes pa'i sku /dkar gsal gangs ri'i ngos la nyi shar 'dra// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mched lnga 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam dran mdzod la// rnal 'byor bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston// bcol pa'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod dgyes pas don 'grub bsam// thun mtshams spyod lam ci bder bya// de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pa yis// rmi lam sngar bas 'gyur zhing dga'// bud med 'du dang zas ster dang*// phyag dang bskor ba byed pa rmi// dngos grub zas nor sprin bzhin 'du/ khyad par bud med bzang mo dang*// yul mi mang po 'du ba yin// 'dod don thun mong dngos grub thob// de ni phyi ltar sgrub pa'o// / rgya rgya rgya/ gnyis pa nang ltar sgrub pa ni// gnas dang dkyil 'khor sngon bzhin te/ khyad par za 'og khug ma ru// shel dang byi ru g.yu chung gzhug /bla rdo lha mo mched lnga ni// dmar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams// dar zab rin chen sna tshogs brgyan// phyed krung 'dzum bcas 'od zer 'phro// tshangs pa lha yi 'jig rten nas// ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim// mchod dang bstod pas mnyes byas la// bdag nyid nyi ma 'od zer gyi// thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul ba yis// 'jig rten skye bo zas nor bcas// skad cig dbang du sdud par bsam// oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra pra mo ha hrīng hrīng sdus sdus ā kar sha ya khug dzaḥ sgom dang bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis// stong gsum 'od dmar gcig gyur nas// rang la thim zhing 'dus par bsam// lha mo mched lnga'i 'od zer las// sprul pa'i lha mo dpag med 'phros// thams cad dbang bsdus bkug par bsam/

khyad par gang dmigs bsgrub bya ni// skad cig bkugs nas dbang gyur bsam// rjes la ci 'byor gtor mas mchod// bstod pa 'di yang brjod par bya// tshangs pa lha yi 'jig rten na// lha mo me tog man dhā ra// dpag med lha yis bstod pa ni// 'jig rten gsum dbang mdzad pa mo// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// ji ltar bdag gis bsam pa bzhin// 'dod dgu'i re ba 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod thun mtshams ci bder gnas// rmi lam skye bo dpag med 'du// nyi zla'i steng gnas lha yul 'gro /bud med 'du dang gter 'don rmi// dngos su gang dmigs dbang du 'du// kun gyi yid 'phrog skye bo 'du// dbang gis dngos grub rgya chen thob// de ni nang ltar sgrub pa 'o// / rgya rgya rgya/ gsum pa gsang bar sgrub pa ni// dben zhing yid dang rjes mthun par// maṇ+ḍal 'dab bzhi dkar ser dmar// ljang dang lte ba mthing ga'i lter// thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng// me long chos 'byung sum brtsegs nang*// hrīḥha ri ni sa lo ka sarba sid+dhi pha la khug dzaḥ zhes pa dang ni phyi rol la// yul dang skye bo'i spel tshig bri// de nyid mkha' 'gro lnga bskyed do// hrīḥlas dbus su ḍā ki ma// dmar nag spyi gtsug rin chen tog /phag zhal mche gtsigs gcer bu la// g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rus pas brgyan// gru mo kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshan pa la// phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa las// gtso mo 'dra ba'i 'khor bskyed do// kun gyi snying khar pad zla dang*// nyi steng hrīḥdamar tsheg drag can// ha ri ni sas bskor ba las// 'od zer 'phro ba bsgom par bya// rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng ni// mthing nag 'jigs pa'i 'od zer gyis// 'og min ye shes bkug la bstim// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod// sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas par bya// oṃ hrīḥha ri ni sa lo ka sarba sid+dhi ā kar sha ya khug khug sdus sdus dzaḥdzaḥtsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ/

bdag gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// mkha' 'gro la phog bskul ma thag /mkha' 'gro'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas// 'jig rten skye bo'i zas nor dang*// gang dmigs bsgrub bya bkug par bsam// yang cig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis// 'dzam gling khyom khyom mer mer la// rgyal po la sogs bkug par bsam// yang cig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis// nam mkha' rgya mtsho rnga lpags la// 'khor yug rnga chen gcig gyur la// nyi zla'i rnga yog gis brdungs pas// bdag gi grags pa'i rnga sgra yis// 'jig rten gsum po kun grags nas// g.yo ldeg mer zhing khyom pa yis// bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam// sngags dang ting 'dzin ma yengs pas// zhag bdun bar du bsgrub par bya// rmi lam khrom 'du skye bos bstod// zas nor char 'bab mkha' la 'gro /gter dang rin chen rnyed pa dang*// dung 'bud rnga chen brdung ba rmi// dngos su 'gro kun dbang du 'du// che btsun thams cad 'du ba dang*// zas nor gter ni rdol ba bzhin// phyogs rnams kun nas 'du ba yin// de ltar grub pa'i rtags byung nas// me long ye shes bdud rtsis bkru /thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od zer gyis// 'jig rten gsum po 'od du zhu// thod pa'i nang thim dmigs nas ni// bdag nyid btung bas dngos grub thob// gsang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di// sgom dang bzlas pa tsam gyis ni// thams cad 'du zhing zas nor 'phel// ci bsam 'grub dang chos 'phel lo// de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dam tshig tu// chags zhen mi bya sbyin par gtang*// bla ma la gus dam tshig bsrung*// rig pa ngar bskyed brtul zhugs bya// gtum mo sbar zhing bde stong bsgom// des ni myur du 'grub pa yin// / rgya rgya rgya/ yang gsang bla na med pa ni// rang nyid pad+ma'i thugs ka ru// hrīḥdang ha ri ni sa las// mthing nag bde chen phag mo ni// phag zhal gcig ste spyan gsum bsgrad// gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// gar byed 'od zer dpag med 'phro// phyogs bzhir de 'dra'i 'khor bzhi bsam// kun gyi thugs ka'i nyi zla las// hrīḥdang ha ri ni sa bsam// de las 'od 'phros snod bcud bsdus// slar 'dus snying ga'i hrīḥl thim// steng 'og rlung ni kha sbyar te// spro bsdu'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin las/

khyad par sna bug g.yas pa nas// rlung ni lcags kyu zhags pa yis// thams cad 'od zhu tshur 'dus nas// sna bug g.yon nas snying gar thim// lus khengs bde dang stong par bsgom// rjes la chos kun rang gi sems// sems nyid ye stong spros dang bral// ma skyes nam mkha'i rang bzhin du// mi bsgom mi bskyed rang sar gzhag /mnyam nyid ye shes gdod ma'i ngang*// rtsa ba bral ba'i rang bzhin du// ye shes rlung gis mthar phyin te// bde chen sa la mya ngan 'da'// 'di ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste// mchog gi go 'phang myur du thob// snga ma gsum ni bskyed pa ste// thun mong dngos grub char bzhin 'bab// de ltar bsgom shes rnal 'byor la// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa kun// ji ltar bskyed rim bsgoms kyang 'dra// snying po'i rdzogs rim kha lo pas// legs bsgyur thar pa'i grong du 'gro /gzhan yang 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid// ji ltar bsgoms kyang blo las 'das// de ltar rtogs te 'khor ba grol// de phyir rdo rje g.yu sgron gyi// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim gnyis kyis// thar lam 'bras bu rab sbyin pas// skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /shin tu yang zab mkha' 'gro'i gnad// bde chen dngos grub gnyis stsol ba// de 'dra rgyal sras pad+ma'i lugs// gang de dri med 'od zer gyis// gcig tu bsdus pa zab mo'i don// ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du// legs sbyar dge bas 'gro ba kun// rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /'di ni rtsa gnas 'khor lo las// yi ge bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis// gnad 'dis myur du 'grub pa yin// skal bzang don du gsal bar byas// dpal rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ ston gsum me tog 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/
gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// /
